Subject: Re: Marketplace path for Redwood — CPPO interest

Diego — thanks for the clear asks. Agreed we should keep this checklist tight so AWS can process quickly. Below is what we'll need and the expected timing: 

1) Commercial docs (required): signed Master Reseller Addendum (stub attached), pricing schedule with SKU-level rates (we've attached v2), and a short PO template (if ResellerCo requires).
2) Compliance/legal: reseller EULA acceptance (one-page), and confirmation of customer data handling boundaries (we default to our hosted API; any private deployment work is handled via our Private product and separate SOW).
3) AWS CPPO form: completed by Redwood to request the Private Offer. We submit this to AWS channel team; typical processing is 3–7 business days after submission, assuming no pricing negotiation.
4) DocuSign routing: Rachel should sign the reseller addendum and pricing. We also need a Redwood signature on the same envelope.

Attachments: pricing schedule (pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx), reseller MSA stub (resellerco_signed_msa_stub.pdf), CPPO request template (cppo_request_form.pdf).

Next steps (proposed):
- Rachel: please confirm final list of named accounts and whether you need per-account discounts.
- Diego: confirm if ResellerCo requires a PO template or standard invoice flow.
- Ben/Marissa: can you validate the SKU list and confirm recommended code/offer names for the AWS listing?

If all materials arrive by EOD Tuesday (11/2) we can submit the CPPO request Wed morning and aim for provisioning the Private Offer by the following Friday.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
